title: It is well made and looks just like picture.
text: It is well made and looks just like picture.. Its very pretty-I thought it was the size of a christmas decoration (wanted to put on my tree) I guess I didn't read the measurements. Its actually large and flat and not really a Christmas decoration so I will save it for Halloween or maybe put it up somewhere as I collect day of the dead figures. It is well made and looks just like picture.

product_metadata.title: amscan Day of The Dead Halloween Party Sugar Skull Hanging Sign Decoration, Multicolor, 12" x 9 1/4"
features: Features a white skull cutout with a red rose on top.
Made of (MDF) medium-density fiberboard with ribbon and a glittery finish.
Decorate your Halloween party by hanging these on walls or doors to set the tone for your party.
description: Have this shockingly shiny black & bone Medium sign glitter its way through the night. This sugar skull is frightfully fancy and is made with tough MDF board and glitters and is reusable for many more holidays to come. Hang it anywhere easily with a ready ribbon on the top. Great for both indoor and outdoor events.
